name: Cheems
subject: Balltze, a Shiba Inu from Hong Kong
origin: A 2017 photo by his owner; first used as 'Cheems' on r/dogelore on 8 June 2019.
attribution: Original photo: Balltze's owner (@balltze), 2017. Cutout template archived by Know Your Meme.
cultural_meaning: A round, smiling, slightly unsure dog who mispronounces words ('cheemsburbger'); later the soft counterpart to Swole Doge — gentleness and vulnerability as comedy.

reflection.en: He looks soft and a little unsure. I know that feeling.
reflection.ru: Он выглядит мягким и немного неуверенным. Мне знакомо это чувство.
reflection.de: Er wirkt weich und ein bisschen unsicher. Das Gefühl kenne ich.

notes: Pose annotated from the widely used template: sitting upright, head turned slightly away. Presentation asset: the sitting-dog cutout under Template on the source page, not the original Instagram screenshot.
discovered_via: manual (Imgflip lists only This Is Fine and Buff Doge vs. Cheems)
